name: B1 core EMA+VWAP classifier
description: Pure core B1 method using EMA240 slope and VWAP drift sign. No OBV, no binning, no FlipGuard, no wagering.

dataset.name: DB_epoch_ochlv_merged_call15s.csv
dataset.description: Epoch-level BTC 5-minute prediction dataset with OCHLV+approx_priceDifference merged at epoch anchors.

anchor_row_definition.description: One anchor row per epoch (previousEpoch), taken as the LAST row for that epoch from the merged OCHLV+epoch table.

EMA240.description: 240-tick EMA of Close over the full OCHLV stream (not just anchors).
EMA240.anchor_value: At each anchor Timestamp, take the EMA240 from the underlying stream row with the matching Timestamp.

EMA240_slope.description: First difference of EMA240 over underlying stream, then attached to anchor rows by Timestamp.

VWAP_5m.description: 5-minute VWAP window aligned to anchor Timestamp t.
VWAP_5m.window: All OCHLV ticks with Timestamp in [t-5min, t].
VWAP_5m.equation: VWAP_5m(t) = sum_i( Close_i * Volume_i ) / sum_i( Volume_i ) over the 5-minute window.

VWAP_drift.description: Relative drift of anchor close vs 5m VWAP.

classifier.name: B1_EMA_VWAP
classifier.notes: EMA240 slope is primary; VWAP drift sign confirms weak EMA regimes.
logic: If ema_abs >= 0.4: predict ema_sign (Bull if >0, Bear if <0).
If ema_sign != 0 and ema_sign == vwap_drift_sign: predict ema_sign.

prediction_pipeline: 1. Load OCHLV stream and epoch metadata from DB_epoch_ochlv_merged_call15s.csv.
2. Build anchor rows: group by previousEpoch and take the last row by Timestamp.
3. Compute EMA240 over the full OCHLV Close stream with alpha = 2/(240+1) and EMA_0 = Close_0.
4. Compute EMA240_slope = EMA240_t - EMA240_{t-1} on the stream and attach to anchors by Timestamp.
5. For each anchor Timestamp t, compute VWAP_5m over all ticks with Timestamp in [t-5min, t].
7. For each anchor, compute ema_sign = sign(EMA240_slope) and vwap_drift_sign = sign(VWAP_drift).
8. Apply the B1_EMA_VWAP logic to get pred_B1 in {-1,0,+1}.
9. Compare pred_B1 to label = sign(approx_priceDifference) for evaluation.

equations.EMA240: EMA_t = alpha * Close_t + (1 - alpha) * EMA_{t-1}, where alpha = 2 / (240 + 1).
equations.VWAP_5m: VWAP_5m(t) = (Σ_{i ∈ window_5min(t)} Close_i * Volume_i) / (Σ_{i ∈ window_5min(t)} Volume_i). The window covers the last 5 minutes of OCHLV rows up to and including the anchor timestamp t.
equations.VWAP_drift: VWAP_drift(t) = (Close_anchor(t) - VWAP_5m(t)) / VWAP_5m(t). Close_anchor(t) is the Close on the anchor row for that previousEpoch.
equations.B1_core_logic:
Let e = EMA240_slope(t), v = VWAP_drift(t).
If e is NaN → pred = 0 (Neutral).
Let a_e = |e|, s_e = sign(e), s_v = sign(v).
If a_e ≥ θ_strong (0.4) → pred = s_e (Bull if +1, Bear if -1).
Else (weak EMA): if s_e ≠ 0 and s_e == s_v → pred = s_e; otherwise pred = 0 (Neutral).
